meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需调取网文拆书、写作与编辑工具，并打开本地工作台
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是网络小说作者，需要一个集中管理拆书、写作与编辑的工作台。
copy.tagline_en: Open the web novel dashboard for story breakdown, writing, and editing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and need one place to manage breakdowns, projects, and edits.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网文工具箱入口，识别写小说、拆文、扫榜、去AI味等请求并自动转到对应工具；也能启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目，以及检查更新。请求不明确时它会先问你。
howto.when: 当你说「/story」等指令，或「我想写小说」「检查更新」等话，或提出网文相关但意图不明的请求时触发。

say.note: 会进入写作工具，开始创建大纲或章节。

say.text: 检查工具箱有没有新版本
say.note: 会查询最新版本并询问是否更新。

say.text: 我要切到另一本书的写作
say.note: 会列出项目里的书并切换当前书目。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude becomes a web-novel toolbox router. It recognizes requests like writing, analysis, ranking, de-AI, etc., routes them to relevant tools; can launch a local Dashboard to view breakdowns and writing projects, and check for updates. If unclear, it asks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter commands like '/story', or say phrases like 'I want to write a novel' or 'check for updates', or make a vague web-novel-related request.

say_en.text: I want to write a long novel.
say_en.note: Enters the writing tool to start an outline or chapter.

say_en.text: Check if the toolbox has a new version.
say_en.note: Queries the latest version and asks whether to update.
Lists books in the project and switches the active one.
